question: Where and how is the worship including vajra and other elements performed?
premises: The ritual includes vajra and other elements
The worship extends to an outer area
The manner of worship has been declared
inference: Thus the worship including vajra and others is declared to be performed outside as well
uncertainties: The specific items included in vajra+ādīni are not enumerated
plain_english: Then, outside as well, the worship including the vajra and so forth is thus declared.
